helpCenter.title: Help center
helpCenter.description: Find answers about email, receipts, and transactions. Each answer links to the place where you can take action.
helpCenter.faqDescription: Open a question to see the next step.

forwarding.question: How do I confirm Gmail forwarding?
forwarding.answer: In Gmail, open the confirmation message received in Anotto and approve the link. Then mark the address as verified in forwarding settings and create a filter for the notices you want to forward.

pending.question: Why is an email still pending?
pending.answer: First confirm the forwarding address in Gmail, then check the email inbox. It shows whether a notice needs review or contains a possible transaction.

duplicates.question: What if a transaction already exists?
duplicates.answer: Before creating another transaction, open the possible matches in the inbox. If it is the same movement, dismiss the notice using the duplicate reason.

receipts.question: How do I review a receipt?
receipts.answer: Upload the image or PDF in Documents. Check the suggested date, amount, currency, and account, then correct each movement before approving it.

balances.question: Why might an account balance differ?
balances.answer: An automatic debit, fee, or older movement may be missing. Review the account's movements and compare them with an available statement before adjusting the balance.

deletion.question: Where can I find account deletion?
deletion.answer: In Settings, open Account and find Danger Zone. You can delete your account and associated data after confirming your email.

aiConsent.title: AI processing permissions
aiConsent.description: Choose which information Anotto may send to external AI services. Each permission is independent and starts off until you enable it.
aiConsent.providerDisclosure: When you enable a permission, Anotto sends the selected data to OpenRouter, which routes it to a third-party model provider, to extract transaction details, suggest categories, or draft automation rules. Provider processing depends on the selected model and provider.
aiConsent.revocationDisclosure: You can turn off any permission at any time to stop future AI requests for that type of data. Review extracted details before creating a financial transaction.
aiConsent.financialTextDescription: Send transaction text from manual entry or connected channels (SMS Shortcuts, Telegram, API and non-forwarded bank notices), plus merchant names for category suggestions and text for automation rule drafts. Manual suggestions for old forwarded email also need this permission.
aiConsent.documentImagesDescription: Send uploaded receipt, screenshot, or statement images for transaction extraction. Uploading alone does not grant permission to extract them.
aiConsent.forwardedEmailDescription: Send the relevant content of verified forwarded bank notices to suggest transaction details and categories. The notices remain available for manual review when this is off.
